R5.arithmetic: Steps name the stock for every part (1/2"x2 board: Long Strips, Blanks, Filler Strips, Tray Bottom, Feet; 1/2" x 1/2" square dowel: Tablet Base, Phone Bases). Board parts per cut list (Kreg-corrected): 4 x 10 + 5 x 5 + 7 x 1 + 2 x 4 + 4 x 1.5 = 40 + 25 + 7 + 8 + 6 = 86 in; 22 parts - 3 boards = 19 cuts x 1/8 = 2.375; 88.375 in <= bought 3 x 36 = 108 in. Dowel: 1 x 10 + 2 x 1.875 = 13.75 + 2 cuts x 1/8 = 14.0 in <= 1 x 36 = 36 in. Pass even if the dowel quantity 1 were an importer default.

R6.reason: No fasteners; glued joints only (glue and felt in materials).

R10.reason: Viewed step images give the positions: phone-base setbacks 1/4 in, 1/2 in, 1 in and 1 7/8 in spans (image 11962b3e), filler block 1 in and 5 in short block (cb2513fd, c2244294), feet 1 1/2 in square and 1/4 in insets (7677bb5e). Tray, final strip and block assembly are fixed by the parts (flush edges, step 7 image 080ba492). The flagged step 0 sentence is general advice, not a placement.
